answer.reason: Edrei is the place where Og king of Bashan came out to battle Israel and was defeated, an event that belongs to the town.

clauses.english: was where Og king of Bashan went out to battle against Israel and was struck down
clauses.quote: Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

doubts: The summary says Edrei is a city in Bashan (DEU 3:10); verses listing it as a city of Og's kingdom or an allotment to Machir's half-tribe (JOS 13:31) add little beyond that, so only the battle is used.
The text says Og dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei, which is unclear and not used.
